# Motha & Maker

> Digital art, made by a human hand. No shortcuts. No generators. Just authentic, human-made art — by Marie Neal, a digital artist based in the UK, creating hand-drawn illustrations one careful line at a time with a stylus, a screen, and a lot of patience. No AI generators are used in any of the work.

Site: https://mothamaker.com

## Galleries

- Animals — Animal illustrations full of character.
- Daily Prompts — A selection of work created through daily prompts and creative exercises.
- Birds — Inspired by Birds.
- Food — Delicious digital treats.
- Nature Echoes — Atmospheric nature-themed artwork.
- Plants — Greenery in bold artistic form.
- Sunflowers — Iconic sunflower studies.
- Winter Olympics 2026 — My highlights of the Winter Olympics.
- Christmas — Festive seasonal illustrations.

## Videos

Time-lapse recordings of Marie's drawing process, published on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@mariewatson3371

## About the artist

Marie Neal is a digital artist based in the UK. Her work spans food and drink illustration, wildlife and nature, and a series dedicated to the 2026 Winter Olympics. About page: https://mothamaker.com/about/
